title: Add Grasshopper Change Entity Params And Passthroughs
description: Compose GH: add param and passthrough component for every compose change entity (kit, design, and all others) and ensure build succeeds.
summary: Refined change components to use native typed diff params/goos for forward/backward and explicit before/after entity naming; added missing native diff param/goo classes for Author, Benchmark, Port, Prop, Tag, Concept, Layer, Group, Stat; updated all change components accordingly and verified net8 build.
